task_context: Credit analyst task: build a 24-month term loan runoff schedule from a term sheet and a monthly cash-flow series, correctly implementing an Actual/360 day-count interest convention over a real calendar (January 2027 - December 2028, spanning two different Februaries with two different day counts) plus an interest-rate covenant and a cash sweep. The core thing to grade is whether the agent correctly derived and applied real calendar day counts (including the leap-year February) instead of defaulting to a flat 1/12 or 30/360 shortcut, on top of getting the covenant/sweep sequencing right.
